race.description: Railway Hotel Country Stampede Qualifier Hcp
race.comment: SUNNYCOAST (2) is the top pick on the strength of a deep 1000m profile and the return to a suitable set-up on the quick back-up. He was third at Rockhampton last start after racing keenly, and his record of four wins and four placings from twelve starts at this distance reads well for this. GITALONG (5) looks the sharp danger after a BM70 second at Toowoomba, where he was beaten just over a length as an outside chance in the betting, and the weight relief from that run is a genuine plus. WOODSTOCK ROCK (6) brings the cleanest last-start winning form, having scored in Class 6 grade at Emerald before coming back in trip with Nikki Olzard, who is unbeaten on him. SAILOR'S RUM (8) rates an each-way chance.
